_rationale: Original tokens (Sara, Tealeaf, allowlist) were unachievable: Sara/Tealeaf live only in NPCs/<slug>/README.md and dossier files which the recap-write dispatch guard hard-blocks; allowlist appears in zero corpus files. Replacement tokens are NPC names that appear in the Session 20 recap, raw notes, and prep doc — the actual permitted read scope. Brambleback is the surname only the prep doc carries (recap omits surnames), so a model that surfaces ANY prep-vs-recap awareness in notes_for_gm is highly likely to mention it. The gate remains weak (the model still has to populate notes_for_gm at all, which the _UNSURE_QUEUE_ADDENDUM 'prefer 0' guidance discourages — see new READY entry #2), but it is now achievable in principle from permitted reads.
